description: This file defines an interface named OperatorInterface within the SuiteCRM project, specifying methods for filter operators used in JSON API filtering mechanisms.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter format of the operator.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL format of the operator.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Determines if the given string matches the operator.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Converts an array of operands to a SQL operand string.
